notes: Opened https://cloud.wikis.utexas.edu/wiki/x/eRBPAg twice, once directly and once through the old wikis.utexas.edu/x/zgFNDg short link, which 301-redirects to it. Both fetches came back empty. The Confluence page is probably rendered with JavaScript, so the fetcher gets no text. I could not get the numeric pageId, so the viewpreviousversions.action history view was not tried. A search snippet only says that NovaSeq X runs are available to UT internal researchers and that the GSAF partners with a local TX Genomics Core for full runs. Search results show several page versions, but their excerpts cut off before any price rows. I saw no NovaSeq 6000, AVITI or Ultima prices and no dated price series, so there is no evidence on 2A/2B. I used 4 tool calls.
how_to_mine: Use a real browser or a headless-browser scraper (Playwright). (1) Open the short link and read the pageId from the canonical URL or from the 'Page History' link. (2) Request https://cloud.wikis.utexas.edu/wiki/pages/viewpreviousversions.action?pageId=<id>. (3) Open each dated version at /wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=<id>&pageVersion=N, or use the diff view /wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=<id>&selectedPageVersions=N&selectedPageVersions=N-1. (4) Extract the NovaSeq X 10B/25B, NovaSeq 6000 and AVITI lane rows, internal and external, for each version date. Confluence REST (/wiki/rest/api/content/<id>/version, then ?status=historical&version=N&expand=body.storage) may also work without login. If the history is login-gated, report blocked.
